the_defect.what_it_looked_like: a relation-aware search oracle added in r151 that checked the produced bytes before calling a goal reached
the_defect.what_it_was: DEAD CODE. env.state() returns a LISTING string ('notes.txt:43:870c73dc8fc8'), not a path. The predicate ran pathlib.Path(listing).rglob(...), found nothing, and every call fell through to `return True`.
the_defect.how_long: two rounds. It was written, measured as 'wired', and reported as working.
the_defect.how_i_caught_it: asked why drive() spent only 8 of a 120-trial budget on a goal no program could satisfy. The answer was that the oracle said YES to any file with the right name.
the_defect.measured_consequence: uppercase ... into loud.txt closed on plan ['run_sort'] in 8 trials, verification correctly rejected the bytes, and the retry loop banned one program per round for 14 s: banned=['run_pgrep','run_pidwait','run_sort','run_tar','run_tree','run_uniq']

the_fix.what: is_goal now reads the produced file from the LIVE sandbox (bound per drive call) instead of parsing a listing string
the_fix.guard_kept: when there is no seed to relate to, or the target has not been read back, it still returns True and lets _verify_plan judge -- the predicate never invents a pass, it only refuses one

measured_after.the_same_unreachable_goal: banned=[] and OPEN__NO_USABLE_PRIOR_EXPERIENCE -- the search genuinely explored and found nothing. Before: six bans and a wrong answer in 14 s. After: no bans and an honest refusal in 32 s.
measured_after.the_honest_trade: correct searching is SLOWER than wrong stopping. 14 s -> 32 s on a goal that cannot be reached, because the oracle no longer ends the search early on a name match.

the_retry_cost_named_and_partly_addresse.mechanism: _MAX_RETRIES=6 re-runs the whole shortlist, banning one action per round
the_retry_cost_named_and_partly_addresse.why_the_retries_existed: the search oracle accepted any file with the right name, so each round stopped at the first wrong program and the ban was the only progress
the_retry_cost_named_and_partly_addresse.what_changed: with a working oracle, a round no longer stops at the first wrong program, so the bans are gone on the unreachable goal (banned=[])
the_retry_cost_named_and_partly_addresse.what_did_not_change: _MAX_RETRIES is still 6 and still re-searches from scratch when every round fails. The tax is now paid once per reachable goal (0 times) and six times per unreachable goal.

the_law_this_round_adds: a predicate that has a fallback branch has to be measured on the branch that runs. A fallback that returns True is indistinguishable from an oracle that agrees -- and I shipped the second while running the first.
